title: Code of Alabama 1975, Title 36, Chapter 27 - Employees' Retirement System of Alabama
source_id: Ala. Code 1975, tit. 36, ch. 27 (s 36-27-1 et seq.)
verified_how: Loaded the register page for s 36-27-1 in a browser: breadcrumb 'Code of Alabama Title 36 Chapter 27 Article 1 Section 36-27-1 Definitions', and the section defines 'RETIREMENT SYSTEM. The Employees' Retirement System of Alabama as defined in Section 36-27-2.' The section is live (not marked repealed).
notes: State and covered local public employees only. Private pensions (ERISA) and Social Security are federal. The chapter caption is not displayed by the register's section view, so the chapter name above is taken from the system's statutory name in s 36-27-1. Teachers are under Title 16, ch. 25.
